title: Journalist
summary: An editorial profile: introduce your beat, show three or four selected reports, then offer approved tip and follow destinations.

notFor: Opinion columnists with no reporting to list (start from creator)

cards.purpose: Orient editors and sources with the beat, outlets, languages and corrections policy.
Three or four selected reports with publication, year and a one-line finding.
An approved sensitive-tip channel first, followed by public email if offered.
The complete reporting archive and places to follow the work.
Selected talks, panels or podcasts, when relevant.

slots.ask: What name do you publish under?
slots.write: Exactly as they give it. Never shorten or translate it.

slots.ask: In one line, what do you do and for whom?
slots.write: One sentence, at most 120 characters, no hashtags or emoji. This appears in the About popover, not beside the name; repeat the essential purpose in the first text card.

slots.ask: What is your beat, which outlets and languages do you work in, and what corrections policy do you want to publish?
slots.write: Start with a descriptive heading and two sentences identifying the beat and reporting focus. Add outlets, languages and a corrections policy only as supplied; do not inherit the sample correction promise. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Share links to three or four stories you are proudest of.
slots.write: Per story: tag = outlet · year; title = the published headline; description = one line on what it found. Newest first. Use only links they give you. Select up to four featured entries for this page; link to the complete archive or catalogue instead of deleting the person’s remaining work. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What should people know before taking this action: who it is for, format, timing, price or reply expectations, only if you want to publish them?
slots.write: One or two short sentences, at most 400 characters. Include only facts supplied for this action; do not assume an introductory call is free or that any date, price or reply time is current. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Do you have a secure way for sources to reach you, such as SecureDrop or a Signal contact page?
slots.write: Their URL only. If they have none, remove the button and drop the SecureDrop sentence from the text. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What short heading should introduce this action?
slots.write: Use a clear heading that describes the action; no unconfirmed availability or promise. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Is there an email address you want to publish for tips? It will be visible to everyone.
slots.write: Only an address they confirm they want public. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Where else can people follow your work (Bluesky, a newsletter, LinkedIn)?
slots.write: The URL only for accounts; the current app shows the host and path when no label is supplied. A label and one-line description only for your own pages. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Any talks, panels or podcast appearances you want to list?
slots.write: tag = format · year; title = the talk or episode title; description = event and city. Select up to four featured entries for this page; link to the complete archive or catalogue instead of deleting the person’s remaining work. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Do you want a place on your profile? A city or region is enough.
slots.write: As they write it. Never infer it.

slots.ask: Do you have a website of your own?
Do you have a photo, artwork or logo you want to upload as the profile picture?
slots.write: The person uploads their chosen picture in the editor. Never fetch, generate or infer a personal photo. Use their description for alt text wherever the editor asks for it.
